name: Capilano (a mountainside course cut through North Shore rainforest)
note: Course theme palette (<= 32 colours), same keys as pnw.json. Capilano Golf and Country Club, West Vancouver, on the slope of Hollyburn Mountain above the Lions Gate (course chat, 2026-11-13). No open orthophoto was found, so the colours are a design, not sampled: a wet coastal-rainforest course, darker and bluer than pnw. Rough a deep moss green, the mown turf a cool, rich green, greens a lighter bent; bunker sand near white (Thompson's flashed white bunkers); water a cold slate. Trees: very tall Douglas fir and western red cedar in near-black blue-green (two conifer tones by variant), with bigleaf maple and red alder among them (trees_capilano.py; a drawing choice, the lidar gives only crown shape). Shadows are a 35% black overlay on top of these.
